description.en: Forces a character to be drawn (a flag of the character) and adds it to the event's list of kept characters. Note that the optional second argument is read as a string: without it the flag is set, but a boolean there reads as no string and clears the flag.
Leave it out to set the flag.

null once done; false if the character is not found.
null too if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: A guest that must stay visible (real usage, from ev42010600.nut)
